title: Handwashing cuts childbed fever deaths
summary: Semmelweis had doctors wash hands in chlorinated lime solution, cutting deaths from childbed fever on wards where mortality was three times the midwives' wards.
why: An early proof that cleanliness saves lives in hospitals.

unsung.contribution: Showed that handwashing with chlorinated lime sharply cut deaths from childbed fever.
unsung.recognition: His idea was largely ignored, rejected or ridiculed; it gained acceptance only years after his death.
